items.source:
Finds classes in a package that are annotated with JsonInclude or have Jackson
annotations.
items.translation: 查找带有 @JsonInclude 注解或具有 Jackson 注解的包中的类。

items.source: Finds all classes in the specified package that match the given type filter.
items.translation: 查找指定包中所有匹配给定类型过滤器的类。

items.source: Discovers all inner classes of a given class.
items.translation: 发现给定类的所有内部类。

items.source: A set of TypeReference objects representing the annotated classes found.
items.translation: 表示已发现带注解类的 TypeReference 对象集合。

items.source:
This method recursively finds all nested classes (both declared and inherited) of
the provided class and converts them to type references.
items.translation: 该方法递归查找所提供类的所有嵌套类（包括声明的和继承的），并将它们转换为类型引用。

items.source:
Utility methods for creating native runtime hints. See other modules for their
respective native runtime hints.
items.translation: 用于创建本机运行时提示的实用方法。有关各自的本机运行时提示，请参阅其他模块。

items.source: packageName - The name of the package to search for annotated classes.
items.translation: packageName - 要搜索已注解类的包名。

items.source: packageClass - The class in the package to search for annotated classes.
items.translation: packageClass - 要搜索已注解类的包中的类。

items.source: packageName - The name of the package to scan for classes.
items.translation: packageName - 要扫描以查找类的包名。

items.source: typeFilter - The type filter used to filter the scanned classes.
items.translation: typeFilter - 用于过滤扫描类的类型过滤器。

items.source: clazz - the class to find inner classes for
Josh Long, Christian Tzolov, Mark Pollack, Fu Jian
A set of TypeReference objects representing the found classes.
items.translation: 代表已发现类的 TypeReference 对象集合。

items.source: a set of type references for all discovered inner classes
items.translation: 所有发现的内联类的一组类型引用
